device_entry.name: RPLIDAR激光雷达
tags: 移动机器人与自动驾驶实验
device_entry.description: 一款通过串口连接的二维旋转式激光雷达，可控制电机转速并启动标准扫描或快速扫描，采集距离点数据并进行实时可视化，适用于环境感知、定位建图和障碍检测等实验。
device_entry.description_en: A serial-connected 2D rotating LiDAR that can control motor speed and run standard or express scans to collect distance points with real-time visualization, suitable for experiments in environment sensing, localization and mapping, and obstacle detection.
